title: Credentialed Git
summary: Repo-local helpers configured by released CLI installs reference the install's yoke-cli-releases/python shim and the shared yoke-cli-releases/github-credential-helper directory, so release pruning leaves them usable. Refresh refuses a missing or non-executable interpreter. Candidate publication validates an isolated helper bundle and checkout references without changing git config; failed publication preserves the previous launcher, shims and release pointer.
